recentItems.title: CNN on the ground in China’s wiped-out border zone
recentItems.description: When flash floods hit the China-Nepal border late last month, surveillance footage captured the dramatic moment a five-story building was engulfed by a wall of water. CNN’s Simone McCarthy was among the first group of foreign media to visit the site and see what it’s like now. #cnn #news #nepal

recentItems.title: Woman shows bloody aftermath of Lake Tahoe otter attack
recentItems.description: A swimmer is recovering after she says she was attacked by a river otter in Lake Tahoe. CNN affiliate KGO spoke with Lynnette Bellin about the incident.

recentItems.title: Unidentified bodies buried in mass graves after deadly floods
recentItems.description: Authorities are burying unidentified victims after the catastrophic Nepal-China floods. CNN’s Hanako Montgomery talks about what she witnessed from reporting on the ground.

recentItems.title: Want to find love? Log off.
recentItems.description: The backlash to dating apps is here. On this week's Engagement Party podcast, Audie Cornish and Ari Shapiro call relationship writer Karley Sciortino to talk about the alternatives which involve (shocker) going outside.

recentItems.title: First Filipina receives star on Hollywood Walk of Fame
recentItems.description: Broadway star and Disney Legend Lea Salonga made history on Friday by becoming the first Filipina to be honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

recentItems.title: Kennedy Center’s ceiling partially collapsed
recentItems.description: Debris was found on the ground at the Kennedy Center after part of a ceiling collapsed, drawing attention to the Trump administration’s calls for upgrades to the facility, CNN’s Betsy Klein reports.

recentItems.title: UN adopts new map to fix world's proportions
recentItems.description: The UN voted to swap the 16th century Mercator map for the more accurate Equal Earth projection. CNN’s Larry Madowo explains the difference between those maps, and why Africa’s size has been minimized for generations.

recentItems.title: Actor reveals why filming iconic 'Shawshank Redemption' rooftop scene was so terrifying
recentItems.description: Actor Clancy Brown explains why shooting the rooftop scene with Tim Robbins in "The Shawshank Redemption" was so frightening.

recentItems.title: US Amb. to Israel meets Palestinian-Americans facing settler attacks
recentItems.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee visited Palestinian-Americans in the occupied West Bank who are repeatedly subjected to Israeli settler attacks. Huckabee, a longtime supporter of Israeli settlements, called the attacks "terrorism" but characterized the perpetrators as a small minority, saying the US has limited leverage over their actions. CNN's Jeremy Diamond pressed the ambassador on those comments and spoke with residents skeptical anything will change. #CNN #israel #palestine🇵🇸
